thread:
Anika Shah: quick async prelaunch check — we're on for the feature-flag rollout tomorrow 10:00 PDT. drop 1-line updates: what you did / blockers / today's plan.

Ben Choi: canary bumped to 4% at 07:12 UTC. p95 and p99 look stable, error rate sitting ~0.2% mainly timeouts on cold starts. planning to hold until 09:00 before 10% bump.

Sasha Li: dashboards ready, added a p95 > 350ms alert and a trace sampling rate bump for canary traffic. left a note on the traces dashboard about sampling. pinging @Ben for trace ids. :eyes:

Ben Choi: @Sasha sending traces: trace-9f2b and trace-9f2c. both show brief GC pauses during long sequences, nothing obvious in model runtime.

David McClure: ran a scaled soak at 3k RPS last night. found a small mem growth in kv-cache when sequence length > 8k. PR opened for a conservative free in the cache path: https://git.internal/r/redwood/kv-cache/pulls/142

Anika Shah: blocker: need approval for two extra burst nodes during the initial ramp window. @Priya Nair — finance ok? we only need them for 48h. :thinking:

Priya Nair: finance thumbs up for a 48h trial of 2 nodes. please add justification in the billing ticket and tag me.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled window: canary rollout start 2076543210 -> 2076543410. command used:
```
redwoodctl rollout --flag enable-llm-v2 --to=canary --pct=4
```

Sasha Li: short ops checklist for tomorrow: 1) confirm error budget pre-rollout, 2) verify log sampling and retention, 3) watch fallback triggers and rate limits. I'll be on-call 09:30-11:30.

Ben Choi: I'll hold on bump to 10% until 09:05 and watch for error spikes. if errors >0.5% revert immediately to v1 via flag.

David McClure: I'll monitor memory and have a hotfix branch ready. runbook here: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/llm-rollout — will post branch link if I cut it.

Anika Shah: quick routing question — anyone seen weird routing mismatches between gateway and dedicated infra that could surface during canary? @Sasha @Ben

Sasha Li: routing sanity check command (run from prod bastion):
```
curl -H "x-redwood-routing: canary" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
works from staging. recommend one prod bastion run before we increase pct.

Ben Choi: running now from prod-bastion — response OK, model v2 header present. :thumbsup:

Anika Shah: great. plan: bump to 10% at 09:10 if no regressions. I'll post another async update at 09:20 with metrics snapshot.

prod-coverage-bot: heads-up — verbose traces retention is set to 2h post-canary by default for coverage.

Anika Shah: thanks everyone. ping me directly if anything pops during the window.
